profile: Independent source and actual CPU integration
scoreMeaning: Required schema placeholder for an unscored correctness review; not a quality score.
verdictScope: The small half-diversion source activation, normal save/restore, restart and the recorded concentration/nav/perception/exposure consequences pass within the stated source/CPU boundary. This does not pass a concept element or any reference criterion.
blindComparison: No blind comparison was performed. The reviewers knew the product identity and used no reference media. No preference is asserted for the named criteria or three-choice quality, and E-13 remains not measured.

target.build: No half-fix build or browser run is asserted; the baseline ae50ac9 distributable does not contain this local change.

measured: Three fresh actual City instances with actual left/no hook, halfVents and shutVents behavior followed by 120 actual Game.fixedUpdate calls at 1/60 s.
Actual GasField sources and samples, bounded live NavGrid refresh and completed A* planned paths.
Actual Enemy.canSee with native CollisionWorld line of sight at the same fixed observer/target coordinates and facing.
Actual Actor._updateVitals/Lungs with a stationary scav and a field frozen after the two-second update.
Separate actual new and ae50-authored save/reset/applySave round trips, old missing-source fallback and unchanged startNewGame callback execution.
substitutions: City Canvas/text/material appearance is stubbed; no rendering occurs.
The perception targets and stationary observer are explicit diagnostic placements, not a recorded encounter.
Storage uses in-memory localStorage; save fixtures omit NPCs/hostiles, use null saved player, and record atmosphere call intents.
The new-game callback is actual source, while HUD/fade/teleport/player presentation uses substitutes; UI/event activation and real Actor motion in that flow are not measured.
notMeasured: Any browser/WebKit/physical-device behavior or performance for this half fix.
Player-screen visibility, actual plume/light pixels or narrative presentation.
Physical execution of the recorded real-City planned routes.
A three-way reference preference or satisfaction of the named 71 criteria.

baseline.interpretation: The new half source fixes the previously unchanged courtyard field. Left and full-closure values are unchanged at the same sampled coordinate and matched update count.

productionCpu.routeLimit: Half and full closure return the same detour for the sampled corridor; only left returns the more direct plan. Three distinct physical routes are not claimed.
productionCpu.navLagLimit: Live navigation is an incremental complete-grid snapshot. At two seconds, half live cost is 4.330374 while a simultaneous direct formula is about 4.370801; no instantaneous equality is asserted.
productionCpu.exposureLimit: The field is frozen after two simulated seconds and the scav does not move or escape. These results quantify game-model consequences, not a playthrough or real physiology.

claims: Current left/half/shut saves include an explicit boolean half-source row and restore the intended normal source configuration.
Actual ae50 left/half/shut saves omit the new source; the missing row is inferred only from the recorded choice flags.
Explicit source booleans remain authoritative; unrelated progression is preserved apart from serialise-generated top-level time metadata.
Actual startNewGame callback clears the three flags, returns both courtyard sources off and restarts the two initial quests.
After restart the live navigation reaches the reset field after one complete bounded sweep, measured at 13 ticks.
saveAndRestart.stabilization: For save/config identity only, gas time and wind are unchanged and globalScale is set to target before actual bake+nav apply. This does not prove restoration of simulation time, wind, transient intensity or pixel appearance.
saveAndRestart.exclusivityLimit: The two courtyard sources are exclusive for normally reachable three-choice states. An intentionally contradictory payload with both explicit source booleans true preserves both; this review does not assert exclusivity for every arbitrary payload.

firstProbeCorrection.reason: Six progression equality controls incorrectly compared top-level t generated anew by serialise(). The raw failure is retained. Version 2 verified that t was the only changed key and excludes only that metadata from semantic progression equality; all 44 controls then pass.

independentRefutation.conclusion: No additional confirmed defect within the source/CPU boundary. The independent reviewer confirmed 44 save/restart controls and checked the 24 consequence controls for unsupported claims. Limits on route identity, rendered vision, fixed exposure and nav lag are retained.

measurementAndInference.measured: Activation booleans, ppm, grid publications/costs, native canSee booleans, planned paths, actor HP/saturation and save/reset/applySave callback outcomes.
measurementAndInference.inference: These source connections show that the half choice reaches navigation, AI perception and the game exposure model. No element-level quality conclusion is inferred from those mechanics.

probeDevelopment.note: A preliminary inline observer-placement probe had one syntax error before execution. The brace was fixed; no product finding or evidence claim was based on that failed parse.
